text:
Irene: FYI saw a 0.45% token shortfall for tenant 'dedicated-us-west' around 2026-03-25 deploy. Pattern: client seq gaps + gateway retry dedupe causing lost metering envelopes. Thinking a reconciler that emits provisional compensating events, with a longer TTL for dedicated tenants.

Noah: Can you paste a sample event?

Irene: sample envelope: {"evt":"e-900","tenant":"dedicated-us-west","user":"u77","seq":4,"tokens":64,"ts":"2026-03-25T15:22:10Z","fp":"fp_deadbeef","prov":"client:gw-v2"}

Tess: Key constraints: append-only, idempotent, auditable. I propose: (1) nightly estimator dry-run, (2) if approved emit `recon:provisional` events with `reconciler_run` and `dedupe_key`, (3) keep provisional visible in UI but not charged until `recon:final` or TTL expiry. For dedicated tenants TTL=21d.

Noah: Dedupe key format: sha256(tenant|user|day|seq_range|est_version). Ingest path should reject duplicates using that key. Also include `est_confidence` score.

audit-bot: Reminder: every reconciler emission must write a proof record to `compact_proofs` with fields (date, tenant, reconciler_run, merkle_root, manifest_uri) so auditors can verify net deltas after compaction. Manifests go to immutable archive.

Irene: Quick SQL to surface candidates:
SELECT tenant,user,date,sum(expected_tokens)-coalesce(sum(tokens),0) as delta
FROM expected_by_seq e
LEFT JOIN meter_events m USING (tenant,user,date)
WHERE delta>0;
(assumes expected_by_seq maps seq ranges to expected_tokens)

Tess: Edgecases: if backfill never arrives, after TTL mark provisional as `final:best_effort` and open CS ticket. Also expose dry-run summary with counts and confidence so ops can approve.

Noah: Ownership: Tess -> UI + CS hooks; Irene -> estimator prototype + runbook; Joel (audit infra) -> compact_proofs + merkle tooling.

ops-bot: alert: dedicated-us-west drop-rate 0.47% (2026-03-25 15:30 UTC) :warning:

Irene: Running dry-run now: `./recon --tenant=dedicated-us-west --since=2026-03-24 --dry-run --out=recon-report.json`. Will post results and a short RFC follow-up.

Noah: One more safety rule to record: never write provisional events to billing ledger without human ticket + `--commit`. Agree?

Tess: Agreed. tagging @Joel for audit signoff. :white_check_mark:
